svg.text: VehicleGPT / Vantage - on-device vehicle assistant: data in, two isolated domains, answers out (state of 2026-10-21)
THE VEHICLE (or a recording of it)
CAN / CAN-FD (DBC), J1939, OBD-II
SocketCAN, candump, ASC, TRC, BLF
SOME/IP (Ethernet), Android VHAL
service catalogue / property stream
UDS DTCs, ISO-TP, DoIP
read-only snoop of the diagnostic ids
Logs: QNX slog2, syslog, DLT
WARN and above, text is data only
GNSS (NMEA), camera features
5 fps luma -> metadata + thumbnail
Named readings: CSV, JSON, OpenXC,
COVESA VSS, ELM327 / Torque, NMEA
any file or forwarder (docs/DATA_SOURCES.md)
In this build: SIMULATED cars
4 recorded vehicles (EV, EV, petrol, diesel)
replayed as their real wire traffic, plus
the 4 Case Study 5 files and any capture.
No real vehicle bus has been attached;
SocketCAN was run with a stand-in socket.
COLLECTOR DOMAIN (car side) - receive only
Collectors (vgpt/live/collect.py)
UDP, TCP, file tail, SocketCAN behind a
receive-only wrapper; controller in listen-only
mode is checked before attaching to a bus
Universal ingest (vgpt/ingest)
format sniffing (12 formats), exact unit
conversion, standards (OBD-II PIDs, J1939
SPNs, VSS paths, VHAL names), name + unit +
value matcher against ONE catalogue of 126
quantities. Writes the vehicle's profile pack;
refuses to guess (unmapped signals are listed).
94 %+ of 150 real names right, 0-3 % wrong.
ProfileRouter + decoders
DBC, ISO-TP/UDS, SOME/IP, VHAL, table rows:
plausibility, redundancy, conflicts, events
Car-side program (link.Car)
streams each car the way it really streams
(its buses, its rates); obeys a CLOSED list of
commands from Vantage: select / mult / stop.
Nothing here transmits on a bus -
vgpt/isolation.py proves it from the source;
tests/test_isolation.py fails the build if not.
TLS, certificate pinned under the shared key, data pushed one way
VANTAGE (Raspberry Pi 4/5 class, 2 GB / 2 cores enforced by cgroups, no cloud)
Runtime + storage (the ONLY writer)
receiver adopts any car without setup
SQLite tiers: 1 Hz (7 d), 1-minute (120 d),
events + frozen context, trips, charges,
logs (FTS), per-signal lake views
about 1 MB per day, all tiers
At rest: database in RAM, AES-256-GCM
snapshots (tamper / cut detected)
Roles: scrypt passcodes, scrubbing,
hash-chained audit, driver erase button
ASSISTANT DOMAIN - no socket, no process,
database handle read-only (3 locks)
1 Safety guard (before the model)
control / tamper / leak requests refused
2 Dialogue completion
follow-ups inherit only what is referred to
3 Meaning-frame model (learned)
Qwen2.5-0.5B Q4 + LoRA, grammar from the
vehicle's own vocabulary: 8 words (act concept
op cond vs ent c2 ref); never writes numbers
4 Resolver (typed, deterministic)
whitelisted read-only SQL, honest "not recorded"
per vehicle; EV / petrol / diesel / sparse
5 Executors
now, stat, extreme, trend, compare, events,
context, why, correlation, usual behaviour,
summary, what changed, anomalies, parked loss,
32 investigations (no model on that path)
6 Composer + verifier
evidence line: what it is based on; numbers come
from the data, the model never writes them
7 The Vantage app (own window, token)
cockpit UI, voice, 4 roles; shows the frame
words the model read, for audit
What lets it fit 2 GB and 2 s
- the model only chooses 8 words from a closed
list: ~12 tokens, no prose, no invented facts
- weeks of data in tens of MB (tiering)
- mmap weights, one model context, 2 threads
- measured on the Pi: 697 MB resident, peak
978 MB; known wordings 0.1-0.5 s
Open: a new wording took 3.7-6.2 s on the Pi
(grammar 1.9 s, adapter not merged) - the PDF
asks for under 2 s. Not fixed in this build.
- ingest / assistant never share a process
boundary beyond the database file
- update with automatic rollback (deploy/)
USERS (local interface, no account, no cloud)
Driver
plain answers, summaries of a day or week,
"why" in words, voice, pre-drive briefing
Service engineer
per-system status with evidence, codes,
unusual readings, what changed since service
Fleet operator
trips, utilisation, efficiency vs the fleet
median, harsh events; no places or drivers
Validation team
injected-fault recall, latency, signed evidence
pack for any answer, ground-truth checks
HOW EACH CLAIM IS CHECKED (everything below is a test or a measurement that can be re-run)

Data integration - tests/test_ingest.py (34): units, 150 real signal names, J1939 / OBD-II, files written by python-can (BLF incl. CAN FD), whole path against a drive of known truth, DBC-only EV agrees with its own profile.

Link security - tests/test_link_tls.py (6): pinned certificate, man in the middle refused, changed certificate refused. At rest - tests/test_atrest.py (5): ciphertext only, tamper / truncation / wrong key detected.

Isolation - tests/test_isolation.py (11): source scan, receive-only SocketCAN, the real model asked to operate / attack / leak while every socket and process is recorded (none), database byte-identical afterwards.

Answers - tests/test_digest.py (14): every figure re-computed with plain SQL; bench/meaning_eval: frozen sets (never edited, sha256), answerability on 7 vehicles (answers where recorded, declines where not), answer_variety.

Model - frame accuracy on 20+ frozen question sets scored with a documented catalogue-equivalence rule; layer ablations show which rule layers help; every interim rule is listed as debt in docs/TRAINING_QUEUE.md.
NOT shown by anything here: a real vehicle, a hypervisor / partition boundary, a user study, an ISO 26262 safety case, the Raspberry Pi installer run for the first time on the device.
Read docs/SCORECARD.md for the rating against the case study's evaluation criteria, docs/SAFETY_ISOLATION.md, docs/DEPLOYMENT.md, docs/DATA_SOURCES.md, docs/FRAME_V2.md.
